source_interpretation: Research facts and public reports; not consented empirical observations, approved profiles or HA hardware verification.

sources.verified_claim: First-time180 and mid-task120 ml. Q40 prewets before each wet task; Q26 returns at5/8/10m² or min (default8); final wash exists but its volume is unstated.
Standard wash130ml/91s; deep215ml/145s. Refill/wash10/15/20min, default15; 3 wetness levels; recommended low/medium at15min. Cross cleaning repeats area twice.
Reference3–4 days for100m² home once daily, balanced wash every20min; not actual wet area or metered depletion.

sources.short_quote: mop-only mode with increased water flow
sources.verified_claim: DirTect increases water flow in mop-only for stains; liftable mop, auto tank refill and detergent. No quantitative adaptive water increment.

sources.short_quote: Smart mode automatically adjusts the water volume
sources.verified_claim: Smart varies volume and duration with dirt; Light uses less, Deep more. Article generic; do not assume every Roborock exposes Smart.
Named Qrevo Pro FAQ has Intelligent/Light/Normal/Deep washing, Smart dirt adaptation, carpet policies; no wash ml.

sources.short_quote: The default wash frequency is set to 15 minutes
sources.verified_claim: Qrevo MaxV default return15min; Smart/Light/Balanced/Deep wash; Pro/MaxV hot wash and dirt-driven remop differ from Plus.

sources.locator: Mop Wash and Auto Dispensing Detergent
sources.short_quote: Support for the Dock function may vary by model.
sources.verified_claim: Wash by room or10/15/20/25min; Smart/Water-Saved/Daily/Deep; Standard/Hot; auto detergent toggle. Article explicitly warns model-dependent support.

sources.short_quote: 95ml tank keeps the mop evenly moist
sources.verified_claim: RV50 Pro v1 UK:95ml robot,5L clean/4L dirty dock;3 output levels;60C wash; dirt-driven rewash/remop; mop lift/removal.
RV50 non-Pro:5L/4L dock,3 output levels, dual spinning mops, recharge/resume; robot water volume unstated.

sources.short_quote: When it is appropriately charged, it will resume cleaning.
sources.verified_claim: RV50 Omni guide describes mid-task and final wash, resume after recharge, and no-dock-map wash restriction. Generic page contains hot-wash troubleshooting; cannot prove non-Pro heater.

Hypothetical daily mop+rinsing scenario roughly500ml, used for detergent-life calculation;1:100 mix and600ml bottle. Not tank capacity or measured fixed cycle. Ambiguous tank boundary prevents a strict reservoir-scoped observation.

sources.short_quote: High Water Volume Mode: Every 15 minutes
sources.verified_claim: X10:80ml robot/3L dock; by-room or15–25min wash; recommends high15/medium20/low25min. Coverage marketing1500–2000ft² up to3 times, no metered rate.

sources.short_quote: The mopping pads will become worn out
sources.verified_claim: Pad wear changes wetting; a room over20m² may outlast pad wetness, so time-based washing is recommended.
Standard/medium reportedly used about50% tank; author extrapolates3L lasts150–170m². No measurement resolution or full raw exposure; report remains approximate.
Two-month use: refill interval approximately200–300m² at medium floor water. Wash settings and measured drawn volume absent.

sources.locator: Comment by InnesPort beginning No problem!
sources.short_quote: weighing the tank when full and after a job
sources.verified_claim: Q8 Max+: weighed full/after-job tank, divided by app area; high water reported0.4g/ft²≈0.4ml/ft². Resolution/repetitions/firmware unknown.
Around250ml per deep rinse, with warning robot-tank refill is another use. In a70m² apartment tank lasted2 whole runs. Instrument/resolution and concurrent refill separation unspecified.
32 floor water levels; optional rewash/remop;80C outlet wash with4 temperature choices; mop lift/detach; automatic robot refill and optional plumbing. No flow per level.
80ml robot and2.5L dock, adjustable water level, automatic wash/refill; up to200m² marketing coverage is not a floor-rate observation.
V50 Complete:50C thermo-fill, adaptive180→260rpm, opt-in CleanGenius rewash/remop,80C outlet wash with4 temperature choices, selectable regular/pet solution. No measured water dose.

sources.short_quote: according to the backwash area you set.
sources.verified_claim: MOVA support: V50 internal refill follows configured backwash area, not internal tank water-level detection.
Track-type warm-water circulation; mop-condition AI triggers rewash, turbidity adjusts wash temperature4modes;75C station wash. No flow rate.
Official MOVA Global description: continuous36C fresh-water spray, dirty collection,75C dock wash. Nominal temperatures do not imply ml/min.
US spec:110ml robot,4L/2.2L dock,50 output levels, sequential option,75C wash, roller32nozzles, dirty-box self-clean. Coverage400m² in table versus500m² battery task text is not consumption.
X8:110ml clean/95ml dirty robot,4L/4L dock,50 output levels,16nozzles,40–75C wash, remop and wastewater scraping. No depletion coefficient.

AU RV50 non-Pro firmware1.2.3 Build260304 Rel022612; app3.21.112; wash8/10/12min and cold wash reported, versus broader manufacturer FAQ10/15/20/25. Approx300ml internal tank has no measurement method.

sources.short_quote: all results demonstrated more than 80 minutes of mopping time.
sources.verified_claim: 200±5ml capacity measured on3 prototypes and >80min standard mopping in4×5m test space; stopping criterion is not stated as water-empty. No safe rate quotient.

sources.short_quote: rinse the roller mop every 55 square meters
sources.verified_claim: S1 Pro recommends55m² roller rinse for larger homes; not evidence of all selectable intervals or S1 non-Pro equivalence.

sources.locator: Qrevo series comparison and Pro detail
sources.verified_claim: Names original Qrevo separately from Pro/MaxV; original uses room-temperature washing. Pro has30 output choices and adaptive rewash/remop; do not transfer those to base.

sources.short_quote: Tapo RV50 Omni, Tapo RV50 Pro Omni
sources.verified_claim: Older regional FAQ associates RV50 Omni/Pro with model-dependent dock-settings article; exact firmware/UI feature presence is still required.

sources.short_quote: dynamically returns to the dock based on real-time water usage
sources.verified_claim: Curv2Flow continuously fresh-rinses a roller with8 hydration points, dirty collection, carpet lift/shield,75C dock wash, dirt-driven rewash/remop and return based on water use. No ml dose.

sources.locator: Dual spinning mops and dock features
sources.verified_claim: Named5AE has30 water-flow choices, liftable rotating mops, self-washing/refill. No flow-per-setting values.

sources.locator: App and control, paragraph at line297; firmware02.13.24/app4.53.08
sources.verified_claim: 5AE deep wash reportedly150–160ml in3min40s; no instrument/sample count. Output1–30, repeats1–2, route overlap2/3/4 and minimum wash10min or by room; no hot wash.
Saved issue12 names QrevoCurv2FlowX/a245 and separate5AE/a170. Profile roborock_qrevo_curv_2_flow appears in reporter Diagnostics. BaseQRevo is not the issue12 identity.
